notes: Two catalogs: tool catalog (ToolRegistry.format_for_prompt) + team roster (MessagingModule, TTL 60s). Dynamic field rendering. XML format. Section key 'teams' for all team context. Preamble configurable via TOML. Deepened with research on: tool description best practices (Anthropic, Claude Code, ADK, OpenAI), XML prompt injection security (4 risk categories, Elastic/Unit42/OWASP), codebase prompt landscape (7 existing subscribers), and implementation considerations (MCP provenance, negative guidance, budget monitoring).
